lines.say: This woman is famous for cruelty,
and the Bible may say the exact opposite.
This is Job Derided,
painted by Gaspare Traversi,
an Italian Rococo painter.
For centuries,
Job's wife has been read
as the villain of his story.
The theologian Abraham Kuyper even called
her Satan's instrument for torturing Job.
And the picture seems to agree.
Her mouth is open at his ear,
and her finger points at him.
But look at her face.
Her brow is tight with worry.
According to the Book of Job,
she asked if he
still held fast to his integrity.
And the word translated as curse actually means bless.
The scholar Ilana Pardes calls
her a victim of the same divine tests.
She isn't Satan's weapon.
She's a second victim of the same test.
So is she mocking him,
or the only one telling him the truth?
